description: Defines the 'channel_state_information' class for representing various measurements related to channel state information in a wireless communication system, including SINR, EVM, RSRP, CFO, and time alignment.

classes.name: channel_state_information
classes.description: Represents measurements related to the wireless channel's state, including SINR, EVM, RSRP, CFO, and timing information.

methods.name: sinr_type_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding SINR type enum.

methods.name: get_sinr_dB
methods.description: Retrieves the SINR value in dB based on the current report type.

methods.name: set_sinr_dB
methods.description: Sets the SINR measurement in dB for a specified SINR type.

methods.name: set_total_evm
methods.description: Sets the total Error Vector Magnitude measurement.

methods.name: get_total_evm
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves the total EVM, possibly combining per-symbol EVMs.

methods.name: set_symbol_evm
methods.description: Sets the EVM for a specific OFDM symbol index.

methods.name: get_symbol_evm
methods.description: Returns a span of EVM measurements per symbol.

methods.name: set_epre
methods.description: Sets the Energy Per Resource Element in dB.

methods.name: set_rsrp_lin
methods.description: Sets RSRP per antenna port in linear units and computes the average RSRP.

methods.name: set_cfo
methods.description: Sets the Carrier Frequency Offset in Hz.
